pattern_rationale: STUB FIXTURE. Nightly export files are the only interface this system offers. Reading every file and keeping the latest row per prescription reproduces current state.

alternatives_considered.why_not: The files are batch exports, not per-event messages.

sync.detail: Once a night, after the export lands.

field_map.transform: A -> active, S -> stopped, C -> completed, else unknown

resources.merge_rule: One MedicationRequest per RX_NO; the row in the latest export file wins.

risks: Data is up to a day old.
A missed export file silently leaves stale statuses.
human_review_points: authoredOn uses the prescription start date; the export has no separate order date.
